evidence.quoted_text:
const res = await execGit(repo, [
    'merge-tree',
    '--write-tree',
    '--no-messages',
    '--end-of-options',
    p1,
    p2,
  ]);
evidence.reason: The supplied implementation calls `merge-tree --write-tree` without disabling external merge drivers. Git's ort merge honors the `merge` attribute and a configured `merge.<driver>.driver`, so repository or global configuration can cause an arbitrary configured program to run during merge evaluation. That is an implementation gap in the intended hardening, not merely an opportunity to add a new requirement.
